description: Acronym & terminology index for the sub0llm project. Project-specific definitions, common LLM/ML terminology, and external references. Keyed by UPPERCASE token for tooltip lookup (Viz: glossary.terms[token.toUpperCase()]).

categories.project: Defined within this project (sub0llm / the diffusion engine)
categories.external: External paper, model, or system referenced by the project

MERA.def: Originally a tensor-network from physics (Vidal); here the recursive log-depth coarsen/refine denoiser (MeraDenoiser) — disentangle (windowed local attention) + coarsen (pool) up to a tiny top, then refine back down with skips. Attention work is O(N*w), linear in N.

DENOISER.def: The baseline bidirectional diffusion model: embed + noise/time conditioning -> full O(N^2) self-attention -> weight-tied LM head. Predicts the clean token at every position. Strictly dominated by MERA on accuracy/compute/context; kept as the reference/accuracy oracle.

HIERDENOISER.def: sub0llm single-level gist model (chapter-32 Phase 2): one coarse global pass over N/c pooled slots + a fine window-local pass conditioned on it. Extends usable context ~c x but its coarse pass is still O((N/c)^2), so it walls; the MERA denoiser generalises it recursively.

GIST.def: In the sub0llm diffusion engine: a low-resolution summary of the sequence (pooled content words or coarsened slots), written G, used to condition fine generation. A COMPUTE/CONTEXT primitive (coarse plan -> parallel fine windows), NOT a within-window accuracy fix — redundant with attention inside a single window.

G.def: Single-letter shorthand used throughout the sub0llm diffusion engine for the GIST: the low-resolution summary vector(s) a coarse pass produces to condition fine generation. Not a standard ML symbol — it is this project's notation. See GIST.

COARSEN.def: Mean-pool every c adjacent positions into one coarse slot (the encode/up step of MERA). Inverse = broadcast (decode/down). c = the coarsen factor per level.

NELBO.def: The masked-diffusion training loss (absorbing-state discrete diffusion, MDLM/LLaDA). Sample noise level t, mask each position with prob t, weight the summed cross-entropy of masked positions by 1/t. Our per-token NLL diagnostic averages over t.

ELBO.def: A variational lower bound on the log-likelihood of the data; maximised when training latent-variable/diffusion models. We minimise its negative (NELBO).

M1.def: sub0llm chapter-32 Phase-0 (instrumentation) metric — per-masked-token NLL split by whether the target is a rare type. NLL_rare / NLL_common is the 'cliff'. Measured ~6-8x on word-TinyStories (rare words predicted far worse).

M2.def: sub0llm chapter-32 Phase-0 (instrumentation) metric — content-word RECURRENCE (fraction of distinct content types reused >=2x) + distinct-n (looping). Validated vs a unigram-chance floor: corpus 5.7x above chance; flat model AT chance.

M3.def: sub0llm chapter-32 Phase-0 (instrumentation) metric — mutual-information / prediction-improvement vs distance; corpus is power-law (alpha~1.8) while a flat model decays exponentially. The multi-scale gap that justifies the hierarchy; vindicated by MERA beating flat on accuracy.

P1.expansion: Phase 1 (sub0llm chapter-32 hierarchy build-out) — char-composition OOV fix
P1.def: sub0llm chapter-32 (ch32) hierarchy build-out, Phase 1: fold sub-word spelling into the word embedding to fix the OOV cliff. FALSIFIED (spelling geometry != prediction geometry under a weight-tied head); the robust OOV lever turned out to be a rare-weighted loss.

P2.expansion: Phase 2 (sub0llm chapter-32 hierarchy build-out) — gist conditioning / coarse-to-fine
P2.def: sub0llm chapter-32 (ch32) hierarchy build-out, Phase 2: use the gist (G) as a compute/context primitive — a coarse plan conditioning parallel fine windows. Built the HierDenoiser + mask-aware pooling.

P3.expansion: Phase 3 (sub0llm chapter-32 hierarchy build-out) — MERA log-depth hierarchy
P3.def: sub0llm chapter-32 (ch32) hierarchy build-out, Phase 3: recursive coarsening (the MeraDenoiser). Removes the O((N/c)^2) wall (linear O(N*w)) and BEATS the flat baseline on accuracy — the M3 multi-scale hypothesis vindicated.

OOV.def: A word/token not (or barely) seen in training -> poorly-trained or missing embedding row. Word-level models fall off a 'cliff' on OOV words (M1).

IB.def: Train a compressed representation to retain only the information predictive of a target. P2 step 2c: make the gist keep long-range predictive info while discarding the rest.

ACT.def: Let the model spend a variable number of compute steps per input/position (Graves). Basis for the per-window verbosity/iteration slider (DESIGN_REVIEW_3 §8).

NLL.def: -log p(target); the per-token loss/quality measure (nats). Lower is better.

CE.def: -sum p*log q; the classification loss between predicted and target token distributions. Our weighted_cross_entropy normalises by the masked-weight sum.

DISTINCT-N.def: Unique n-grams / total n-grams in a passage. Higher = less degenerate repetition/looping. Part of M2.

LLM.def: A neural network trained on large text corpora to model token sequences.

BPE.def: Subword tokenizer that greedily merges frequent byte/char pairs. We also use a word-level tokenizer for analysis.

ROPE.def: Encodes token position by rotating query/key vectors by a position-dependent angle; relative-position aware. NTK-scaling extends it beyond training length.

RMSNORM.def: Normalises activations by their RMS (no mean subtraction); cheaper than LayerNorm, used throughout the modern blocks.

SWIGLU.def: FFN variant: (Swish(xW) * xV)W2 — a gated activation that outperforms plain GELU FFNs.

GQA.def: Attention where several query heads share each key/value head — between MHA and MQA; cuts KV-cache memory with little quality loss.

MHA.def: Standard attention with H independent query/key/value heads.

MQA.def: All query heads share a single key/value head (extreme GQA); minimal KV cache.

KV-CACHE.def: Cached attention keys/values from past tokens so autoregressive decode is O(n) not O(n^2). Less relevant to bidirectional diffusion.

FFN.def: The per-position MLP in a transformer block (here SwiGLU).

MOE.def: Sparse FFN: route each token to top-k of many expert MLPs + a load-balancing loss. Ch18.

MTP.def: Predict K+1 tokens per forward pass (extra heads). Ch19.

LORA.def: Fine-tune by adding trainable low-rank matrices to frozen weights. Ch12.

DPO.def: Align a model to preference pairs directly (no separate reward model/RL). Ch13.

RLHF.def: Train a reward model from preferences then optimise the policy against it (KL-penalised). Ch20.

PPO.def: A clipped policy-gradient RL algorithm commonly used for the RL step of RLHF.

STE.def: Backprop through a non-differentiable (e.g. argmax/routing) op by passing the gradient through as if it were identity. Used by the MathGPT router (Ch21).

ADALN.def: Condition a model by predicting per-channel scale/shift for its norm layers from a conditioning vector (FiLM-style). A way to inject the gist.

FILM.def: Condition features via a learned per-channel affine (gamma*x+beta) from a conditioning input.

GELU.def: Smooth activation x*Phi(x); common transformer nonlinearity.

ADAM.def: First-order optimizer using running estimates of gradient mean and variance. AdamW adds decoupled weight decay.

MDLM.def: Absorbing-state discrete diffusion for text; its Rao-Blackwellised objective is our NELBO. The training recipe behind the engine.

LLADA.def: A masked text-diffusion LLM; reference recipe (low-confidence remasking, etc.) for our sampler.

DIFFUSIONGEMMA.def: A real ~26B text-diffusion LLM run locally as a correctness/behaviour oracle; diffusion is GPU-favorable on 8GB (hybrid offload).

MASKGIT.def: Iterative confidence-based parallel decoding (commit the confident, re-predict the rest) — the sampler pattern our refine_canvas uses.

TITANS.def: A test-time-learned long-term memory module (Dec 2024); prior art surveyed for the Ch26 episodic-memory design.

TTT.def: Update (part of) the model on the test input itself at inference; a fast-weights / online-adaptation approach (Ch26 prior art).

CLS.def: Neuroscience theory: a fast episodic store (hippocampus) + slow semantic store (cortex). Framing for the Ch26 three-tier memory design.

CHINCHILLA.def: Compute-optimal scaling: ~20 tokens per parameter. Our 5M-param models on ~37K tokens are ~2700x under-resourced -> word-salad generations (the data ceiling, not an engine fault).

FLOPS.def: Compute throughput measure; FLOPs (no s) = a count of operations.

TG.def: The decode phase throughput (tokens/s) — generating new tokens. Contrast PP.

PP.def: The prefill phase throughput — processing the input prompt before generation. Contrast TG.

TTFT.def: Latency from request to the first generated token (dominated by prefill).

VRAM.def: GPU memory. The binding constraint at long context (8 GB here); flat O(N^2) attention exhausts it ~N=1024-2048.

TDR.def: Windows GPU watchdog that resets the driver if a kernel hangs; VRAM exhaustion can trigger it (and a reboot). Why the ceiling shows as thrash-then-crash.

WDDM.def: Windows GPU driver model; oversubscribes VRAM by spilling to system RAM -> catastrophic slowdown (thrash) rather than a clean OOM.

SIMD.def: CPU vector instructions (AVX2/AVX-512) that process multiple values per instruction; the CPU kernels are SIMD-dispatched.

AVX.def: x86 SIMD instruction sets (AVX2 256-bit, AVX-512 512-bit). The native build targets the host's exact set.

FMA.def: a*b+c in one rounded instruction; key for matmul throughput and -ffp-contract=fast.

FTZ.def: CPU modes that treat denormal floats as zero; set at startup to avoid a ~4x slowdown when Adam state goes denormal late in training.

LR.def: Optimizer step size; scheduled (warmup/decay) by the trainer.

GENERATIONTRACE.def: The engine-emitted JSON artifact for the Viz: per-iteration frames (tokens, masked, committed, confidence, entropy, commit order) + optional per-MERA-level digests. Lets you scrub the diffusion 'thought process'.

VERBOSITY-SLIDER.def: Future feature enabled by the gist: separate meaning (G) from surface, exposing two knobs — refinement depth K and realization length N — as a meaning-preserving terseness/verbosity/latency dial.
